versions.subject: Added rule for Arcadyan Router Exploitations
versions.detection:
path_traversal:
  c-uri|contains:
    - '..%2f'
noauth_list:
  c-uri|contains:
    - '/images/'
    - '/js/'
    - '/css/'
    - '/setup_top_login.htm'
    - '/login.html'
    - '/loginerror.html'
    - '/loginexclude.html'
    - '/loginlock.html'
condition: path_traversal and noauth_list
path_traversal:
  c-uri|contains|all:
    - '..%2f'
    - 'apply_abstract.cgi'
noauth_list:
  c-uri|contains:
    - '/images/'
    - '/js/'
    - '/css/'
    - '/setup_top_login.htm'
    - '/login.html'
    - '/loginerror.html'
    - '/loginexclude.html'
    - '/loginlock.html'
condition: path_traversal and noauth_list
